As Apple continues to expand support for its Car Keys feature across the automotive industry, the function appears to be coming soon to select models from a major Chinese carmaker. Here are the details.

Apple Wallet's Car Keys reportedly to support GWM Tank

According to MacRumors, new backend code suggests that Apple may soon extend support for Car Keys in Apple Wallet to Tank models under GWM.

Several GWM models already support Apple CarPlay, including the Tank 300, Tank 400, Tank 500, and Tank 700, as well as vehicles from its Haval, Ora, Wey, and Poer brands.

However, none of these models currently support the Car Keys feature, which allows drivers to lock, unlock, and start compatible vehicles using an iPhone or Apple Watch.

This news comes just days after new backend code indicated that Car Keys would support Volkswagen models. Apple is continuing to expand the reach of Car Keys following the recent rollouts from Toyota and Rivian.

In 2025, Apple announced that an additional 13 car brands would adopt Car Keys, including GWM's Wey, alongside Acura, Cadillac, Chery, Chevrolet, GMC, Hongqi, Lucid, Porsche, Rivian, Smart, Tata Motors, and Voyah.

According to Apple's official website, more than 800 vehicle models currently support CarPlay, of which 52 also support the Car Keys feature. For the full compatibility list, please visit this link.
